sources.title: The Polygenic Score Catalog as an open database for reproducibility and systematic evaluation
sources.access_status: Bibliographic record confirmed by web search 2026-09-06; publisher full text not read in this session. The Catalog's REST API and FTP scoring files were used directly and are the operative source for every number reported.
supports: An open, curated database of published polygenic scores with variants, alleles and weights
Programmatic access to score metadata and scoring files
The 88 published coronary-artery-disease scores used as the size ladder
does_not_establish: Validity or clinical utility of any individual score deposited there
That the linkage-equilibrium assumption made in this work holds for any of them
Any result about coronary artery disease

sources.title: Published polygenic scores for coronary artery disorder (MONDO_0005010), and the effect weights of eight of them
sources.venue: PGS Catalog REST API and FTP scoring files. Derived quantities and file digests retained in results/pgs_catalog.json; scoring files not redistributed
sources.access_status: Fetched live on 2026-09-06. Each scoring file's SHA-256 digest, size and source URL are recorded so the run can be repeated. Files are used under the Catalog's terms and are not redistributed with this work.
supports: 88 published scores for one phenotype, from 27 to 7,082,943 variants
Real effect weights, and published effect-allele frequencies for two of the eight scores used
The size ladder against which the four regimes of Section 15.2 are tested
does_not_establish: Any clinical claim; no individual risk is computed anywhere in this work
Validation or criticism of any deposited score
That the scores are mutually independent, which the analysis assumes and which is false for LD-aware methods

sources.title: Genetic risk, coronary heart disease events, and the clinical benefit of statin therapy: an analysis of primary and secondary prevention trials
sources.venue: The Lancet. PMID 25748612. Deposited as PGS000010
sources.access_status: Bibliographic record taken from the PGS Catalog entry for PGS000010, fetched 2026-09-06. Full text not read in this session; the score's weights, not its clinical conclusions, are what this work uses.
supports: The smallest published coronary-artery-disease score in the Catalog, 27 variants
Effect weights and effect-allele frequencies used in Section 16
does_not_establish: Any clinical claim reproduced or evaluated here
That 27 variants are sufficient for any purpose

sources.title: Integrative polygenic risk score improves the prediction accuracy of complex traits and diseases
sources.access_status: Bibliographic record taken from the PGS Catalog entry for PGS004744, fetched 2026-09-06. The scoring file was not downloaded; only its published variant count is used, as the basis of a labelled extrapolation.
supports: The largest published coronary-artery-disease score in the Catalog, 7,082,943 variants
The upper end of the size range against which the regimes are tested
does_not_establish: Any measured result; this score is used only for its variant count
Any evaluation of the PRSmix method
